enrichment.core_claim: Consciousness science should turn intractable puzzles like solipsism, zombies, and the self into axioms, as physics did with laws of the impossible.
enrichment.ask_question: Which of the three problems do you think is closest to yielding a falsifiable axiom?
enrichment.challenge_question: Physics impossibility laws came with predictive theories; what predictive theory would follow from axiomatizing solipsism?
